system.bio:
Original STTH game by McShmoodle. Homebrew Egg Breaker Boss inspired by Shadow the Hedgehog. Not printed STTH statistics. Uses the system’s pilot-operated NPC model. Single-target attack rolls work normally; shared mace state, cockpit bonuses, surface shockwaves, multi-target attacks, cooldowns and temporary Dodge require GM handling.

Cockpit Weak Point: Before rolling, a character with line of sight and sufficient height/range may target the cockpit at -1 Advantage. A damaging hit deals +3 HP damage; no extra critical, pilot damage or separate cockpit HP. GM applies penalty and extra damage. Does not make ordinary attacks ineffective.

Piloted War Machine: Dr. Eggman is the default pilot. Set a pilot Actor UUID to use the system’s existing pilot inheritance; physical Speed/Power and printed combat skill overrides belong to this chassis. Pilot and mech share one turn/action budget while piloted; do not give the pilot extra attacks through this profile. HP is the chassis’s, not the pilot’s. Defeat disables the mech; GM determines pilot escape.

Breaker Weapon Cycle: All mace attacks use one spiked-ball weapon. Launching it temporarily disables the melee mace choices; use Heavy Fist or Ground Shockwave instead. Every listed attack uses its own Action. Sweeps and shockwaves do not trigger each other or produce free follow-up attacks. Disabling the arm removes all mace attack choices. GM tracks the shared weapon state.

Heavy Chassis: Token is 3 by 3 squares, ground movement 2; no sustained flight. Measure reach from token edges. HP represents armor durability; no additional damage reduction. Mechanical suffocation immunity applies only to the chassis: an exposed living pilot still needs air.

Vehicle-sheet adaptation: original HP, Dodge, movement and attack damage retained. Weapon rolls use the assigned pilot. Original NPC initiative and exceptional actions remain reference notes; apply with the GM. HP N/A or zero-HP base chassis and parts must be configured for an encounter before taking damage.

system.description: Action; one target within 2 squares of token edge. Requires available mace. No additional free shockwave.

Action; forfeit Interact. One visible target within 8 squares; normal cover and line of sight. The mace is unavailable after launch until the end of Egg Breaker’s next turn; during that interval it cannot use Mace Smash or Mace Sweep. Cannot launch on consecutive turns. No free return hit. GM tracks availability and phase cost.

Action; forfeit Move. Choose up to 3 different grounded opponents within 2 squares of token edge, with an unobstructed path along the same surface. Roll separately; each target can be hit once. Airborne or physically separated targets are unaffected. Cannot use on consecutive turns. This is a separate attack, not damage automatically added to Mace Smash or Ball Launch. GM handles targets, surface checks and cooldown.

Action; forfeit Move and Interact. Requires available mace. Choose up to 3 different targets within 2 squares of token edge; separate rolls, each target at most once. Cannot use on consecutive turns. After resolving Dodge becomes 1 until the start of the next turn. GM handles targets, phase cost, temporary Dodge and cooldown.
Action; one adjacent target. Available while the spiked ball is launched. No automatic knockback or grab.

system.bio:
STTH 1.5.0, p.162. Final Boss.
55 HP for the head/torso part. Hands have independent HP. Colossal body/parts must be positioned to match the encounter layout.
Pilot-operated: listed mental values use Dr. Eggman as the default pilot. Set the pilot Actor UUID to inherit a different pilot’s Dexterity (plus this profile modifier), Intellect, Charisma, and skills; printed skill ranks override pilot ranks. The GM resolves firing position and movement.

Vehicle-sheet adaptation: original HP, Dodge, movement and attack damage retained. Weapon rolls use the assigned pilot. Original NPC initiative and exceptional actions remain reference notes; apply with the GM. HP N/A or zero-HP base chassis and parts must be configured for an encounter before taking damage.

system.description: Burning on second hit; 3×3 AoE; three Interacts to recharge.
Inflicts Stunned and Dazzled; three Interacts to recharge.

After both hands are destroyed, spend Move or Interact (not both) to destroy an adjacent platform square. Affected characters save at Difficulty 1 Acrobat/Ride to an adjacent intact square; failure or no square causes a fall.
